text: A fraction describes equal parts of a whole. The numerator counts the parts selected, while the denominator counts the total number of equal parts. For example, three quarters means three of four equal parts.
To add fractions with the same denominator, add their numerators and keep the denominator. One quarter plus two quarters equals three quarters because the parts are the same size.
A function is a named block of reusable code. It can accept inputs called parameters and return a result. Small functions with clear names are easier to test and maintain.
A loop repeats an operation for each item in a sequence or while a condition remains true. A loop should always make progress toward its stopping condition to avoid running forever.
Katika Kiswahili, neno maji humaanisha water kwa Kiingereza. Sentensi fupi inaweza kusaidia mwanafunzi kukumbuka maana ya neno katika muktadha.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kujifunza msamiati kwa kusoma, kusikiliza, kuandika na kutumia maneno mapya katika sentensi. Mazoezi ya mara kwa mara husaidia kukumbuka.
